## What's inside
| Plugin | What it does | Install |
| **Share Link** `@vlln/dsh-share-link` | Publish a conversation or an artifact as a read-only publi

c link; revoke anytime. | `github:vlln/dsh-share-link` |
| **Video to Text** `dsh-video2text` | Vide
o link → script: sidebar player, transcript, export; bundles the `video2text` skill. | `github:vlln/

dsh-video2text` |
| **Pancha** `dsh-pancha` | A directory as a board you can audit, annotate and act

on — the agent labels, you decide. | `github:vlln/dsh-pancha` |
| **Loop** `@vlln/dsh-loop` | Sched

uled loops: `/loop` command, `loop` tool and a live activity bar. | `@vlln/dsh-loop` |
| **Auto Fork
** `@vlln/dsh-autofork` | When the agent is busy, fork the session: the new instruction runs now, th

e old turn reports back later. | `github:vlln/dsh-autofork` |
| **Whale Girl** `whale-girl` | A desk

top pet for the DSH Web GUI. | `whale-girl` |
| **Evolution Engineering** `@vlln/evo-engineering` |
Improve any artifact in rounds: standard, iterate, independent review, rollback. | `github:vlln/evo-

engineering` |
| **PR Inbox** `dsh-pr-inbox` | A sidebar panel for the GitHub PRs that concern you:

opened, to review, merged — over your local `gh` login. | `github:omdsh-dev/dsh-pr-inbox` |
| **Pres
et Inspector** `dsh-preset-inspector` | See where every line of an agent preset comes from: patch la
yer, package, config. | `github:omdsh-dev/dsh-preset-inspector` |
### Archived
Still installable by name, just no longer maintained — so they are not in the index.
| Plugin | What it does | Install |
| **Navbar** `@vlln/dsh-navbar` | A node rail on the conversation's right edge: jump between user me

ssages. | `@vlln/dsh-navbar` |
| **Task Status** `@vlln/dsh-task-status` | A status bar for backgrou
nd jobs: per-task progress plus a live output tail. | `@vlln/dsh-task-status` |
## How this repo works
| Path | Role |
| `plugins/*.json` | Hand-written display facts only: title, description, category, keywords, icon |
| `scripts/build-index.mjs` | Probes the real facts (npm versions + publish times, or the default-b
ranch HEAD commit and its manifest), merges, validates with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market-index`,

writes `index.json` |
| `index.json` | The generated index — the only file a client reads |
| `.gith
ub/workflows/index.yml` | Daily rebuild; commits only when `index.json` actually changed |
Versions are what is actually published: npm-published plugins list their npm versions, git-only plu

gins list the
default-branch HEAD commit. When a repo is ahead of npm, the index keeps the published

version — install from git if
you want the bleeding edge.
## History
Until 2026-10-03 this repo hosted a **thin console** (a browser panel managing a profile's plugin in

stall state) and a
copy of the `make-dsh-plugin` skill. DSH's own Plugins page took over the console

's job, the skill moved to
vlln/dsh-skills, and on 2026-10-21 the repo became this index.
